name: Funding-OI joint fragility gate — daily momentum continuation on confirmed positioning (long, 1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: the joint-fragility continuation gate read on a DAILY clock with a multi-day hold — targeting the slower swing trend rather than the intraday leg. A daily momentum entry (positive ret_Nd) is taken ONLY when positioning confirms a healthy new-money trend: funding_rate NEUTRAL (no crowded-long carry drag) AND open_interest RISING with price (fresh OI sustaining the move). We ride continuation SPOT (direction +1) while the book is healthy and step aside when funding spikes or OI stalls. Distinct from variant 19 (4h clock / faster hold) — the daily cadence isolates the multi-day swing component and uses funding accrual (funding_feature) over the longer hold. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the positioning gate does not improve a plain daily-momentum baseline on the SAME bars net of fees — else decorative curve-fit. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the four-condition daily gate fires too rarely for effective-N, or if the benefit is entirely from dodging 1-2 crash days (regime-luck, not repeatable structure).
catalyst: positive daily momentum gated by neutral funding and rising OI — a healthy multi-day trend to ride long.
